episodes.synopsis: Priestess is worried about the possibility of ranking up and Goblin Slayer encounters a strange bespectacled boy.
episodes.title: An Ordinary Spring Day

episodes.synopsis: Priestess leads her first quest with the usual party but they also bring Wizard Boy along. They go to a mausoleum in search of a party of adventurers that went there prior but never came back.
episodes.title: The Red-Haired Wizard Boy

episodes.synopsis: Many of the guild adventurers are spending time training outside of town. While there Goblin Slayer is invited for a guys' night out to which he acquiesces.
episodes.title: The Training Grounds on the Outskirts of Town

episodes.synopsis: Goblins ambush some rookie adventurers on their way back home from training and it's up to Goblin Slayer and the other higher-ranking adventurers to save them.
episodes.title: Onward to Adventure

episodes.synopsis: High Elf Archer receives mail about a wedding. She invites the rest of the party to join her in attendance. With plans to travel via river the group is warned that many boats have recently been sunk.
episodes.title: Beard-Cutter, to the Southern River

episodes.synopsis: Having successfully navigated the goblin-infested cliffs along the river, Goblin Slayer and the others make camp and are come upon by a helmeted elf who turns out to be the High Elf Archer's cousin.
episodes.title: The Elven King's Forest

episodes.synopsis: Goblin Slayer and the crew have encountered the Mokele Mubenbe and, much to their surprise, it's being ridden by a goblin. After capturing Mokele Mubenbe Goblin Slayer decides to head upstream in search of the goblins' nest.
episodes.title: Jungle Cruise

episodes.synopsis: While searching the abandoned building, Goblin Slayer and the others come upon a goblin horde led by a shaman presumed to be the one who was controlling Mokele Mubenbe. The adventurers press the attack but are overwhelmed by the shaman's magic.
episodes.title: Heart of Darkness

episodes.synopsis: After returning from a mission in which there were no goblins, Goblin Slayer and the others are tasked with being the archbishop Sword Maiden's bodyguards to protect her from goblins on her trip to the capital.
episodes.title: Once There Was Youth, Now There Is Nothing but Ash

episodes.synopsis: The party arrives at the capital and splits ways. The girls go to a public bath and as they're about to leave, they find that Priestess's belongings have been stolen.
episodes.title: City Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Goblin Slayer and party head into the Dungeon of the Dead to go save the Princess.
episodes.title: The Princess's Ordeal

episodes.synopsis: Goblin Slayer and party manage to save the Princess but end up having to face a rather unexpected, terrifying foe.
episodes.title: O Prayers, Have You Reached Heaven?
